newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 302 OF OCTOBER 12, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 302 OF OCTOBER 12, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
Corrigendum to cover of Official Journal of the European Communities No C 287, of 30 September 1996 (96/C 302/10)

Phare - modernization of a national road Within the framework of the European Commission Phare Cross-border Cooperation Programme Poland-Germany Regional Board of Public Roads in Zielona Gora Invites contractors who meet the conditions and have sufficient experience and references to participate in the international open-tendering procedure (96/C 302/09)
Phare - wide-area network Notice of invitation to tender issued by the Ministry of Agriculture on behalf of the Government of Hungary for a project financed from Phare funds (96/C 302/08)
Amendment to notice of invitation to tender for the refund for the export of milled medium-grain and long-grain A rice to certain third countries (96/C 302/07)
Prior notification of a concentration (Case No IV/M.843 - PTT Post/TNT/GD Express Worldwide) (96/C 302/06)
Prior notification of a concentration (Case No IV/M.836 - Gillette/Duracell) (96/C 302/05)
Authorization for State aid pursuant to Articles 92 and 93 of the EC Treaty Cases where the Commission raises no objections (96/C 302/03)
Communication of Decisions under sundry tendering procedures in agriculture (cereals) (96/C 302/02)
